settings.headline: What's Really In The Bowl
settings.text: Most pet food brands list 'meat meal' or 'animal by-products' as their top ingredient. We use real, identifiable ingredients: deboned chicken, wild-caught salmon, organic sweet potato, and fresh spinach. Every ingredient is human-grade — meaning we could eat it ourselves (though we prefer our own meals).

reviews.name: Dr. Meera K.
reviews.text: As a practicing vet, I recommend PawPal to my clients because the ingredient transparency is unmatched in India. Human-grade protein, no by-products, added probiotics — this is what pet food should be. I feed it to my own 3 dogs.

items.question: What does 'human-grade' mean?
items.answer: Every ingredient in PawPal meets human food safety standards. Our chicken is the same quality you'd find in a grocery store, not rendered scraps from a processing plant. We could legally sell our ingredients as human food (but we'd rather feed happy pets).

items.question: How does Subscribe & Save work?
items.answer: Choose your pet's food, set your delivery frequency (every 2, 4, 6, or 8 weeks), and save 20% on every order. Pause, skip, or cancel anytime with one click. Free delivery always. We'll send a reminder 3 days before each shipment.

items.question: My pet is a fussy eater. Will they like it?
items.answer: 85% of fussy eaters take to PawPal within the first serving. If your pet doesn't like it within 7 days, we'll refund your full order — even if the bag is half empty. We call it our Tail Wag Guarantee.

items.question: Can I switch between flavors?
items.answer: Absolutely! Variety is healthy for pets. You can switch flavors with each subscription delivery. We recommend transitioning gradually over 5-7 days by mixing old and new food, but most pets handle PawPal transitions smoothly thanks to our mild, digestible formulas.
